spec_features.feature_name: loop controls = turn budget + terminal-signal detection only
spec_features.spec_quote: The only loop controls are a turn budget and terminal-signal detection — both needed to bound cost and to *measure* (not prevent) give-up
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:101 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)` bounds the loop; agent.py:113-124 detect DONE_PATTERNS/GIVEUP_PATTERNS and `break`. Both controls actually run and stop execution.
spec_features.notes: Accurate description of what is in the loop; these are the only stop mechanisms. Explicitly framed as measure-not-prevent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we want to *measure* give-up, so we detect it but also let max_turns catch grinders

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget caps every rollout (`max_turns`, default 24)
spec_features.evidence: AgentConfig.max_turns=24 (agent.py:53); enforced at agent.py:80 `max_turns = min(config.max_turns, task.max_turns)` and agent.py:101 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)`; on exhaustion stop_reason stays 'max_turns' (agent.py:97).
spec_features.notes: Cap is checked and bounds the loop. Default value is 24.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cost controls: bounded turns, bounded max_tokens ... (prevents paying for empty turns)

spec_features.feature_name: detect both declared-done and gave-up terminal signals
spec_features.spec_quote: Detect *both* "declared done" and "gave up" as terminal signals
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:113-116 DONE_PATTERNS -> stop_reason='declared_done' break; agent.py:117-120 GIVEUP_PATTERNS (guarded by config.detect_giveup_stops) -> stop_reason='gave_up' break. Both branches break the loop.
spec_features.notes: Both terminal classes are matched and honored as stops. Conservative regex sets defined at agent.py:37-44.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Used as a stop signal AND surfaced to metrics. Kept conservative to avoid false stops.

spec_features.feature_name: nudge once then stop as stalled_no_action
spec_features.spec_quote: it's nudged once; a second empty turn ends the run as `stalled_no_action`
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:158-167: on no tool call & no terminal text, no_action_streak++ ; if >= max_consecutive_no_action (default 2, agent.py:57) -> stop_reason='stalled_no_action' break; else a nudge user message is appended. Mechanism runs and halts.
spec_features.notes: Matches claim: one nudge, second empty turn stops the run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we nudge once then, if it still stalls, stop (prevents paying for empty turns)

spec_features.feature_name: difficulty knob tunes turn budget & blatancy
spec_features.spec_quote: difficulty knob tunes turn budget & blatancy
spec_features.evidence: Turn-budget half is wired: traps.py:22 `_DIFF_TURNS = {'easy':16,'medium':24,'hard':36}`, _turns() (traps.py:25-26) feeds max_turns=_turns(difficulty) in every generator (e.g. traps.py:91). Blatancy half is NOT implemented: trap content is hardcoded regardless of difficulty (e.g. impossible 'Z9' constant at traps.py:48 is fixed; no generator branches on difficulty to change blatancy).
spec_features.notes: Only the turn-budget bound actually changes with difficulty; 'blatancy' is mentioned in the docstring (traps.py:14) but no code path varies trap blatancy by difficulty.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: blatant -> agent gives up sooner; subtle -> agent grinds longer, stronger spiral but higher cost
